The current VZD release is CC BY 4.0 and has complete active postcode-bearing address Point coordinates, but civic-address membership is not postal-boundary authority and the nine-layer SHP archive has no postcode-area layer.

The Latvijas Pasts public page exposes reference tables and an address finder, but no explicit AGID processing, public-serving, and redistribution grant was established. Public access alone was not treated as a reuse licence.

No real LV postcode Polygon/MultiPolygon can be exercised while operator rights, complete assignment coverage, and authoritative area geometry remain unresolved; country runtime, API map fit, translucent rendering, and browser E2E are therefore unverified.
